definitions.explanation: How often something happens within a given period or population. Common in statistics, medicine, and quality control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発生頻度|はっせいひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発生頻度|はっせいひんど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The occurrence frequency of this error is low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発生頻度|はっせいひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We compared the incidence of the disease by region.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧ (occurrence, outbreak) and ⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧ (frequency).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発生頻度|はっせいひんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high / low frequency of occurrence
- {発生頻度|はっせいひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to reduce the frequency of occurrence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発生率|はっせいりつ}: occurrence rate, incidence rate — expressed as a proportion or percentage
- ⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧: frequency — the general term
